newsitem.title: USA: Gensym Corp sees Q1 EPS of $0.02 or less.
newsitem.headline: Gensym Corp sees Q1 EPS of $0.02 or less.

text.p: Gensym Corp said Friday that it expects revenues for the quarter ended March 31 be approximately $10 million, as compared to $8.4 million in the year-earlier period, while earnings will be no more than $0.02 a share, compared with $0.06 per share.

The company said the revenues are lower than it expected. Gensym said it attributed the lower than expected revenues and lower earnings primarily to a substantial investment in a strategic reorganization and retraining of the sales force, which is expected to eventually lead to increased productivity and revenues.
The company also said it experienced a shortfall in bookings in the quarter, especially in the United States market, where the changes it made were more extensive.

Because of its long selling cycles, the short-term effects of its actions will likely extend into the second quarter, but the company said it is optimistic about prospects for meeting revenue goals the latter part of the year.
Gensym supplies software and services for intelligent systems that include scheduling, energy and environmental management, and abnormal situation management.
